requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

3497-4399-4770--228.easyPrerequisites: You've gained at least 1 life this turn.
3497-4399-4770--228.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Ezzaroot Channeler.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3497-4399-4770--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1274-2034-3490-8319.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2034-3490-8319.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1409-4506-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Auriok Champion trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

4694-4802-5330-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-4802-5330-7306.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

339-677-3899-6968.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

618-4681-8095.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide with haste.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

710-3899-7424.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

261-1981-2415-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
261-1981-2415-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

413-3197-4153--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures also triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 through 5  once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat from step 7.

851-4772-6441-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

465-670-1619-6135.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
465-670-1619-6135.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Aarakocra Sneak.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, it triggers, returning Aarakocra Sneak from exile to the battlefield.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Aarakocra Sneak.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 5.

4508-4875-7746.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4508-4875-7746.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as HYDRA Assault Robot is a Pirate due to Conspiracy, creating a Treasure token
When the Treasure enters, HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

2438-6553-7424.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1387-1500-2871-7425.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Birgi, Blood Funnel and Prismari Pianist trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Prismari Pianist trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7379.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Zack Fair.
When Zack Fair dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

650-891-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

851-3129-4682-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
851-3129-4682-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Primal Vigor and Adrix and Nev.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
851-3129-4682-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3062-3088-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Xenic Poltergeist
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

141-1269-2292.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1269-2292.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

856-1477-3263-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

413-2173-3661-5220.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Shield Sphere enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

339-647-677-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a coin counter on it

1349-2921-6863--133.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Dinosaur in your hand.
1349-2921-6863--133.description:
Cast the Dinosaur in your hand by paying its mana cost. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, Athreos's second ability triggers, returning the Dinosaur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1495-4613-6627-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and The Earth Crystal.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more +1/+1 counters on it

645-2060-3750-4659-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-2060-3750-4659-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer, adding {C}{C}.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

777-1690-2364-2538.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact permanent in hand that can be cast for at most {1} due to Foundry Inspector.
777-1690-2364-2538.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying at most {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Vault to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost reduced by {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
777-1690-2364-2538.notes: You can use an artifact creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

803-3767-3918-3941.description:
Activate Trazyn using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

790-4651-5076.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
790-4651-5076.description:
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Kederekt Parasite triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

56-1417-2523-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-1417-2523-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Bridge from Below and Ratadrabik of Urborg trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-1417-2523-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

2284-2351-4639.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Glare of Subdual by tapping a blue creature you control except Unctus.
The creature triggers, causing you to loot.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Glare of Subdual ability.
Repeat.

38-2420-3139.notablePrerequisites: Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-2420-3139.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Scuzzback Marauders enters the battlefield, The Great Henge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scuzzback Marauders and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

147-1223-4050.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
147-1223-4050.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding one mana of any color.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.

2341-4659-4909.description:
Activate Melira by exiling it.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Melira's ability.
Resolve the copy of Melira's ability, choosing The Peregrine Dynamo.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing The Peregrine Dynamo, adding {C}{C}.
Melira triggers, returning The Peregrine Dynamo from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

950-3069-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
950-3069-5256.description:
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Fatestitcher's unearth ability by paying {U}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield and giving it haste until end of turn.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Fatestitcher.
Choose to exile Fatestitcher using Void Maw's replacement effect instead of Fatestitcher's.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Fatestitcher's power.
Activate Void Maw by putting Fatestitcher from exile into your graveyard, giving Void Maw +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2815-4050-4891-5184-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Atsushi, adding {R}.
Atsushi dies, triggering itself and Mortuary.
Resolve the Atsushi trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, causing you to put Atsushi on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, exiling Atsushi from the top of your library and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Activate the three remaining Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Cast Atsushi from exile by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2942-3059-5253.notablePrerequisites: Brion does not have summoning sickness.
2942-3059-5253.description:
Activate Brion by paying {R}, tapping it and sacrificing Malignus, dealing damage equal to three times Malignus's power to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
